# Musician's Friend

> Musician's Friend is a comprehensive online musical instruments retailer offering 30,000+ guitars, drums, keyboards, and pro audio gear from major brands with expert support and customer-friendly policies.

Musician's Friend serves musicians of all levels with an extensive product catalog, competitive deals, and a loyalty rewards program. The site features detailed product categories, expert Gear Advisers for personalized guidance, and a 45-day return policy to support customer confidence.

## Guitar Categories

- [Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/guitars): Shop 30,000+ new and used guitars from Fender, Gibson, Taylor and more.
- [Electric Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/electric-guitars): Browse 20,000+ electric guitars from major brands with free shipping.
- [Solid Body Electric Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/solid-body-electric-guitars): Shop 20,000+ solid body electric guitars from Fender, Gibson, PRS and others.
- [Acoustic Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/acoustic-guitars): Shop 7,000+ acoustic guitars from Taylor, Martin, Yamaha and Fender.
- [Acoustic-Electric Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/acoustic-electric-guitars): Shop 3,700+ acoustic-electric guitars from Taylor, Fender and Yamaha.
- [Semi-Hollow & Hollow Body Electric Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/semi-hollow-and-hollow-body-electric-guitars): Browse 3,000+ semi-hollow and hollow-body guitars from Gibson and Epiphone.
- [6-String Acoustic Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/6-string-acoustic-guitars): Browse 6,500+ six-string acoustic guitars including dreadnought models.
- [12-String Acoustic Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/12-string-acoustic-guitars): Shop new and used 12-string acoustic guitars from Martin and Taylor.
- [Left-Handed Electric Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/left-handed-electric-guitars): Shop left-handed electric guitars from Fender, Gibson and Ibanez.
- [Nylon-String & Classical Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/classical-nylon-guitars): Classical nylon guitars from Cordoba, Kremona and Ortega.
- [Extended Range Electric Guitars](https://www.musiciansfriend.com/extended-range-electric-guitars): Extended-range 7-12 string electric guitars from Fender, Ibanez and Schecter.
